summary.text: David Dolan is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 148 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Dolan is an attorney and served as a judge on the 33rd Circuit Court from 1998 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: David A. Dolan earned a bachelor's degree and a law degree from the University of Memphis, the latter in 1981.
He worked as an attorney in private practice from 1982 to 1990, as assistant prosecuting attorney for Scott County from 1986 to 1990, and as Scott County prosecuting attorney from 1991 to 1993.
Ballotpedia also lists him as associate circuit judge for Scott County from 1992 to 1994 and judge of the 33rd Circuit Court from 1998 to 2024.
Dolan took office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Jamie Burger.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Judiciary and Children and Families committees and two joint committees.
